public.text: “Evals” are introduced as a discipline but are not defined in a way that distinguishes technical model evaluation from clinical validation, safety assurance, usability testing, or real-world monitoring.
public.suggestedRevision: Define a layered evaluation framework covering technical performance, clinical or operational validity, human factors, equity, security, workflow impact, prospective testing, and post-deployment monitoring.
